newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Latest Yeltsin check-up shows no deterioration.
newsitem.headline: Latest Yeltsin check-up shows no deterioration.

text.p: Doctors found no deterioration in President Boris Yeltsin's health during an examination carried out in a Moscow hospital around 5 p.m. (1400 GMT) on Thursday, a Kremlin spokesman said.

"During an evening examination the doctors found no negative changes in the president's condition," he told Reuters. "He is continuing to follow the same treatment. His temperature is normal." Yeltsin, 65, was taken to hospital on Wednesday after showing signs of pneumonia.

Doctors and Kremlin aides have insisted the pneumonia, which followed an announcement on Monday that the president had a heavy cold and a temperature, was not connected to the quintuple heart bypass operation he underwent on November 5.
The Kremlin has said Yeltsin is being treated with antibiotics at the elite Central Clinical Hospital.
